home.about_p1: The magnificent and gracefully carved Saligrama deity of Lord Shri Venkataramana, presiding in Melangadi of Kalasa town, presents a spellbinding sight of supreme tranquility.
home.about_p2: Lord Shri Venkataramana has lovingly fulfilled every cherished prayer of the devotees who surrender to His benevolence. Along with the primary deity, statues of Shri Varadaraja Swamy, Shri Anjaneya Swamy, and consecrated Saligramas reside in the sanctuary.
home.about_p3: During major annual celebrations, Shri Varadaraja Swamy and Shri Anjaneya Swamy are joyfully carried on the divine street procession (Pete Utsava). To the right side of the inner sanctum is the shrine of Lord Brahma.

ds_exp_0: Shreemat-ramaaramana: Lord who pleases the mind of Lakshmi (Ramaa).
ds_exp_1: Venkata-shaila-varyaat daagatya: Graciously arrived here from the supreme Venkatachala hill (Tirupati).
ds_exp_2: Agastya-muni-nirmita-kalashaakhye: Named 'Kalasa', which was established by Agastya Maharishi.
ds_exp_3: Tat-deshake pura-vara-uttama-kalashaakhye: In Kalasapura, which is the most supreme among all towns in that holy land.
ds_exp_4: Tishthan: O Lord who resides and stands here.
ds_exp_5: Tvadeeya-bhajakaan-avaloakayasva: Look upon and protect with your merciful gaze the devotees worshipping you.
ds_exp_6: Shree-vaarijodbhava: Lord Brahma, who was born from the lotus.
ds_exp_7: Bhava: Lord Shiva, the destroyer of the universe.
ds_exp_8: Indra: Indra, the king of the devas.
ds_exp_9: Khagendra: Garudadeva, the king of birds.
ds_exp_10: Poorva maulistha-sanmukuta-ghattita-paadapeetha: When all of them bow down in line to offer salutations, their crowns touch and rub against the Lord's footstool.
ds_exp_11: Santapta-haataka-vinirmita-mantapastha: O Lord who is seated in a grand pavilion made of pure, well-melted gold (haataka).
ds_exp_12: Shreekalashaakhyapuranayaka sannamaami: I offer my prostrated salutations to you, the leader of the beautiful city named Kalasa.
ds_exp_13: Kunda-indu-goksheera-samaana-varnam: Having a white color similar to kunda gems (white flowers), the moon (indu), and cow's milk (goksheera).
ds_exp_14: Sat-hemadanda-anvita-chaamara-dvayam: The service of a pair of chawris (fly-whisks) fitted with superior gold handles.
ds_exp_15: Bhoogeendra-bhooga-upama-vetra-yugmam: A pair of royal scepters/canes (vetra yugmam) as beautiful as the expansive body of Adishesha.
ds_exp_16: Dayaanidhe tvam krupayavaloakaya: O ocean of mercy, kindly behold/listen to this grand service taking place before you.
ds_exp_17: Samasta-pradhvaanta-bhide: Tearing apart and destroying all the darkness of the world.
ds_exp_19: Tigmaamshu-vaishvaanara-sannikaashe: Radiating with a brightness equal to the splendor of the sun and blazing fire (vaishvanara).
ds_exp_21: Pancha-shirah-pradeepike: This grand aarathi having five faces/heads.
ds_exp_22: Ramaapate tvam krupayavaloakaya: O Lord of Lakshmi, kindly accept this auspicious deepaarathi.
ds_exp_23: Bheeree: Nagari or large kettle drum instrument.
ds_exp_32: Vaadyaani chitraani cha zharzharaani: Along with these, various designs of 'zharzhara' (jingling bronze gongs).
ds_exp_33: Aakarnyataam susvara-ranjitaani: May the Lord listen to the music of all these instruments rendered in melodious notes.
exp_0: Svargavanaalvanatanayana: Indra is the ruler of heaven; his son is Arjuna.
exp_1: Ter-kudureya pididu: Holding the reins of the horses of Arjuna's chariot on the battlefield.
exp_3: Devara deva: Lord of all gods.
exp_4: Rukmini-praananaathane: Lord Krishna, the lord of Rukmini's life.
exp_5: Rigvedavane keluu: Listen to these ancient Rigveda mantras.
exp_6: Krupaangavara shreeranga: O Lord, whose very form is made of mercy.
exp_7: Bahuparaak svaami: O Lord, royal greetings (Bahuparaak).
exp_8: Sevamavadhaaray: Please accept this devotional service.
exp_9: Aja-janaka: 'Aja' refers to unborn Brahma; Lord Vishnu is the father who created him.
exp_10: Nityarchita: One who is worshipped daily by sages and devas.
exp_11: Bhajakara-vaanchitavanu-eeva: The giver who fulfills the desires (vaanchita) of devotees who worship him.
exp_12: Trijagannaayaka: Ruler of the three worlds.
exp_13: Bhujagana meloregida: Resting on the king of serpents, Adishesha (Ksheerabdhisayana).
exp_15: Baliyolu bhoomiya beduta: Approaching King Bali and begging for three paces of land.
exp_16: Bhangava bidisida: Removing the distress/humiliation of the devas (or breaking King Bali's pride).
exp_17: Saamaveda-aagamavane: The musical chants of Samaveda.
exp_18: Premadi keluu: Listen with great love.
exp_19: Pruthvishara vamshavanella: All the lineages of the tyrannical Kshatriya kings ruling the earth.
exp_20: Matta-hananava maadi: Destroying (hanana) the intoxicated (matta) kings.
exp_21: Mereda bhaargava roopane: Gloriously excelling as Parashurama (Bhargava) of the Bhrigu dynasty.
exp_22: Pratividyavane keluu: Listen to this supreme knowledge (Atharvana) that protects against enemies.
exp_23: Vastrava seleyalu: When the Kauravas were dragging away the saree in the assembly.
exp_24: Drupadaputriya: Draupadi, the daughter of King Drupada.
exp_25: Maanava kaayde: Protected her honor by granting endless garments (akshaya vastra).
exp_27: Shastrajitaatmaja priyane: 'Shastrajit' is Arjuna who wins with weapons; his son (aatmaja) is Abhimanyu, or Krishna who is dear to Arjuna.
exp_28: Vaarija-naabhane: Lord Vishnu, who holds a lotus (vaarija) in his navel.
exp_29: Vishwa preraka: The driving energy behind all living beings in the universe.
exp_30: Paavana-charita: Whose divine history purifies the listeners.
exp_32: Kaaranika nigama-aagama: The prime source of the Vedas (Nigama) and scriptures (Aagama).
exp_33: Shraddhaanvitanenisi: Appreciating the sincere devotion of devotees.
exp_35: Hrun-manadoliddu: Residing as the indweller in the heart and mind.
exp_36: Salahidaatane: The one who nurtures and protects us.
exp_37: Uddharisi kaava: The God who lifts us out of the worldly ocean and saves us.
exp_38: Gadyavane keluu: Listen to this devotional prose poem unconstrained by meter.
exp_39: Gangeyan-ungutadin-padeda: One who created the holy Ganga from his big toe during Trivikrama incarnation.
exp_41: Mangala mahima: One whose glory brings immense auspiciousness.
exp_42: Sangara-angana-dheerane: One who stands courageous on the battlefield (sangara).
exp_44: Raama tapovana-abhigamanam: Sri Rama departing to the forest (tapovana) where sages reside.
exp_45: Hatvaa mrugam kaanchanam: Slaying the illusionary golden (kaanchana) deer.
exp_46: Vaideehi-haranam: Abduction of Sita (Vaidehi), the daughter of King Videha.
exp_47: Jataayu-maranam: Jatayu the bird sacrificing his life fighting to rescue Sita.
exp_48: Sugreeva-sambhaashanam: Friendly dialogue and alliance with Sugriva in Kishkindha.
exp_50: Samudra-taranam: Crossing the ocean to reach Lanka (building the bridge).
exp_51: Lankaapuree-dahanam: Burning of Lanka, the city of demons, by Hanuman.
exp_52: Pashchaat-raavana-kumbhakarna-mathanam: Thereafter (pashchaat), crushing (mathanam) the formidable demons Kumbhakarna and Ravana.
exp_53: Eetat-hi raamaayanam: This indeed is the sacred story of Ramayana.
exp_54: Naaganaam-ayutam: An army of ten thousand (ayutam) elephants.
exp_55: Turaga-niyutam: An army of one hundred thousand (niyutam) horses.
exp_56: Saardham rathaanaam shatam: Along with hundreds of chariots forming a massive array.
exp_57: Padaatim shatakoti: Infantry soldiers numbering one billion (shatakoti).
exp_58: Sainya-nrupate: Among the kings of such a massive demon army (Ravana and others).
exp_59: Eekaaki-bandhau rane: Standing alone on the battlefield without an army, Sri Rama, the sole protector (bandhu) of all.
exp_60: Eevam koti-kabandha-nartana-vibhoh: O Lord who made millions of headless torsos (kabandha), severed by Rama's arrows, dance.
exp_61: Kinchit-dhvani kinkinee: The slight sound (kinchit dhvani) of Sri Rama's bow string sounded like jingling anklets (kinkini)!
exp_62: Yaama-artham: In just half a yaama (about 1.5 hours).
exp_63: Raghupate kodanda kanthaaravah: The roar (kanthaaravah) from the bow 'Kodanda' of Raghupati obliterated that entire army.
exp_64: Ahalyaa-shaapa-vimochana: One who liberated Ahalya from her curse (turning her from stone back to human) with the dust of his feet.
exp_65: Sharadhi-bandhana: One who bridged and bound the salty sea (sharadhi) to reach Lanka.
exp_66: Raavana-mardana: One who crushed (slayed) Ravana, the embodiment of ego, in battle.
exp_67: Vibheeshana-saamraajya-paripaalaka: One who crowned Vibhishana as king of Lanka and protected his kingdom.
exp_68: Dushta daanavara mardisi: Slaying the evil demons.
exp_69: Srushtiya bhaaravane kaledu: Relieving Mother Earth of the burden of sinners.
exp_70: Ishtaarthavaniva: God who grants what devotees desire.
exp_71: Srushtipati kashtanaashane: Lord of creation, who destroys our troubles.
exp_72: Ashtakavanu keluu: Listen to this collection of eight devotional stanzas (Ashtaka).
exp_74: Devaki-devi-garbha-jananam: Being born from the womb of Devaki in the prison of Mathura.
exp_75: Gopee-gruhe vardhanam: Growing up (vardhanam) in the home of Yashoda among the gopis in Gokula.
exp_76: Maayaa-pootani-jeevita-apaharanam: Slaying the deceptive demoness Putana by sucking away her life (jeevita) when she came to feed poisonous milk.
exp_77: Govardhana-uddhaaranam: Lifting Mount Govardhan on a pinky finger to shelter Gokula from Indra's torrential rain.
exp_78: Kamsa-chhedana: Beheading and killing Kamsa, the cruel king and maternal uncle.
exp_79: Kaurava-aadi-mathanam: Destroying the army of evil Kauravas in the Mahabharata war.
exp_80: Kuntee-suta-paalanam: Protecting Kunti's sons, the Pandavas (especially Arjuna), at every step (paalanam).
exp_81: Eetat-bhaagavata-puraana-punya-kathitam: All these holy deeds described in the Bhagavata Purana.
exp_82: Shreekrishna-leelaamrutam: The sweet nectar-like divine play (leela) of Lord Krishna.
exp_83: Kastooree-tilakam lalaata-phalake: Wearing a kasturi tilak on the wide forehead (lalaata).
exp_84: Vakshashtale kaustubham: Wearing the shining Kaustubha gem on his chest (vakshasthala).
exp_85: Naasaagre nava-mauktikam: Wearing a bright new pearl (mauktikam) nose-ring on the tip of the nose (naasaagre).
exp_86: Karataleeveenum: Holding a flute (veenu) in the palm (karatale).
exp_87: Kare kankanam: Wearing beautiful bangles/bracelets (kankanam) on the wrists.
exp_88: Sarvaange harichandanam: Applying fragrant sandalwood paste (harichandanam) all over the body.
exp_89: Kanthe cha muktaavalee: Wearing a pearl necklace (muktaavali) around the neck.
exp_90: Gopasthree-pariveshtito: Surrounded (pariveshtita) by the gopi maidens.
exp_91: Vijayate gopaala-choodaamanih: Lord Krishna, the crest-jewel (choodamani) among cowherds, shines supreme.
exp_92: Shaanta-aakaaram: Possessing a serene and calm countenance even in difficult situations.
exp_93: Bhujaga-shayanam: Reclining on the thousand-headed serpent king, Adishesha.
exp_94: Padma-naabham: Having a lotus emerging from his navel, which gave rise to Lord Brahma.
exp_95: Suresham: The supreme Lord of all devas (Sura + Eesha).
exp_96: Vishwa-aadhaaram: The singular foundational pillar supporting the entire universe.
exp_97: Gagana-sadrusham: Boundless and all-pervading like the infinite sky.
exp_98: Megha-varnam: Having a dark dark-blue hue like rain-bearing clouds.
exp_99: Shubhaangam: Having a divine form with most auspicious and beautiful limbs.
exp_100: Lakshmee-kaantam: Beloved husband of Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth.
exp_101: Kamala-nayanam: Possessing wide, merciful eyes like lotus petals.
exp_102: Yogibhih-dhyaana-gamyam: Revealed within the inner hearts of great yogis meditating upon him.
exp_103: Vandee vishnum: I bow down to that Supreme Lord Vishnu.
exp_104: Bhava-bhaya-haram: One who destroys (haram) the fear of the cycle of birth and death (bhava bhaya).
exp_105: Sarva-loka-eeka-naatham: The sole protecting master of all worlds.
exp_106: Shankha chakra-ankitane: Bearer of the sacred conch and discus emblems on his hands.
exp_107: Poleva kaustubha-dhara: Adorned with the sparkling Kaustubha gem on his chest.
exp_108: Omkaaradi ghudighudisuva: Resonating deeply like 'Omkara', the primordial sound of the universe.
exp_109: Shankha dhvaniyanu keluu: Listen to the sound of this conch, reminiscent of Panchajanya.
exp_110: Kauravabhoomi sharapaalara: The great archers (Bhishma, Drona, etc.) in the Kaurava army.
exp_111: Shauryavane seledu: Shattering their pride and valor in battle.
exp_112: Sharanuhokka salahidaatane: Protecting the Pandavas who surrendered to him.
exp_113: Mauri seveyanu kelvudu: Listen to the deep, melodious sound of this 'Mauri' wind instrument.
exp_114: Shauri: Lord Krishna, the grandson of Shurasena.
exp_115: Sujanaantakara: Poetically rendered; refers to the indweller in the hearts of good people (Sujana-antaranga) or the destroyer of evil.
exp_116: Shrutimauri: A specialized wind instrument similar to Nadaswaram providing drone pitch.
exp_117: Taala-tambata: Cymbals providing rhythm along with 'tambata' (a type of percussion drum).
exp_118: Ati-ravasadolu-uliva: Resonating enthusiastically with great speed and vigor.
exp_119: Kombu kahala-aaravadim: With the grand sound of 'Kombu' (horn) and 'Kahale' (bugle) blown for royal honor.
exp_120: Joteyenipa sarvavaadyava: The combined music generated by all these musical instruments together.
exp_121: Ratipati-pita: Father of Manmatha, the husband of Rati.
exp_122: Keluu krupaangavara shreeranga: Listen, O merciful Lord Ranganatha.
exp_123: Bahuparaak svaami...: O Lord who delights in all instrumental music, please accept this grand offering.
